sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
paragraphs: Whether you're preparing for your first game or looking to improve your high score, this page answers the questions players ask most often about ZXSpace.
As ZXSpace continues to evolve, this FAQ will be updated with new gameplay information, additional features and future content.

faq.question: Is ZXSpace available on the App Store?
faq.answer: ZXSpace is currently approaching release. It will become available on the Apple App Store once development and testing have been completed.

faq.question: Is ZXSpace free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. ZXSpace is free to download, with optional cosmetic content available through the BarkinMad Coins progression system.

faq.question: What type of game is ZXSpace?
faq.answer: ZXSpace is a fast-paced retro-inspired space shooter where you defend cities against waves of invading aliens using a single player-controlled cannon.

faq.question: How do the controls work?
faq.answer: Move your cannon by dragging left and right across the screen. The cannon fires automatically, allowing you to focus on positioning and avoiding enemy attacks.

faq.question: Does the cannon fire automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. Automatic firing allows players to concentrate on movement, positioning and collecting power-ups.

faq.question: Can I pause the game?
faq.answer: Yes. ZXSpace includes pause functionality so you can temporarily stop gameplay before continuing your defence.

faq.question: How do I earn BarkinMad Coins?
faq.answer: BarkinMad Coins are earned through normal gameplay by completing waves and continuing to improve your performance.

faq.question: What can BarkinMad Coins be used for?
faq.answer: Coins unlock cosmetic cannon skins and other cosmetic rewards across supported ZX Series games. They never provide gameplay advantages.

faq.question: Are BarkinMad Coins shared with other ZX Series games?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported ZX Series games share a common BarkinMad Coin wallet, allowing your progress to continue across multiple titles.

faq.question: Do BarkinMad Coins have any real-world value?
faq.answer: No. BarkinMad Coins are an in-game progression system only and cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred outside supported ZX Series games.

faq.question: Does ZXSpace support Game Center?
faq.answer: Yes. ZXSpace integrates with Apple Game Center for achievements and leaderboards.

faq.question: How do I unlock achievements?
faq.answer: Achievements unlock automatically as you reach gameplay milestones while signed into Apple Game Center.

faq.question: Do achievements affect gameplay?
faq.answer: No. Achievements simply recognise your progress and do not provide gameplay advantages.

faq.question: What power-ups are available?
faq.answer: ZXSpace currently includes power-ups such as Double Laser and Shield Repair, with additional power-ups planned as development continues.

faq.question: Do power-ups last forever?
faq.answer: Most power-ups provide temporary advantages, encouraging players to use them strategically during each wave.

faq.question: How can I improve my score?
faq.answer: Focus on surviving longer, maintaining accurate positioning, collecting power-ups and defending every city for as long as possible.

faq.question: Will ZXSpace receive updates after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. Future updates may introduce additional gameplay features, cosmetic content, balance improvements and quality-of-life enhancements.

faq.question: Is ZXSpace part of the ZX Series?
faq.answer: Yes. ZXSpace is one of the growing collection of ZX Series arcade games developed by BarkinMad Studios.
